subject: pathology
title: Male genital pathology: prostate, testis, penis and scrotum

steps.tx: **Benign prostatic hyperplasia** (dihydrotestosterone driven **transitional zone** nodules with bladder outlet obstruction, hesitancy with nocturia and retention) is treated by **alpha blockers** (tamsulosin relaxing smooth muscle) then **5 alpha reductase inhibitors** (finasteride shrinking), with **TURP** for refractory or complicated disease (retention, stones, renal injury). PSA rises modestly with volume; biopsy only when cancer suspected. Chronic prostatitis (pelvic pain with cultures often negative) differs by tenderness with antibiotics debated.
steps.say: Transitional zone nodules blocking old men are BPH: block alpha, shrink with finasteride, resect when complicated.

steps.tx: **Prostate adenocarcinoma** (peripheral zone, **Gleason score** grading glands, PSA screening debates, **osteoblastic bone metastases** with high alkaline phosphatase) is managed by risk: active surveillance (low risk), prostatectomy or radiotherapy (localised), **androgen deprivation** (leuprolide, bicalutamide, orchidectomy) for advanced with docetaxel or abiraterone added. Back pain with high PSA in elders seeds spine; cord compression (steroids with urgent decompression) threatens. Prostatitis and BPH raise PSA benignly; density and velocity refine.
steps.say: Peripheral zone hard nodule with high PSA is cancer: Gleason grades. Osteoblastic spine mets mark prostate: deprive androgens.

steps.tx: **Testicular germ cell tumours** (young men, **cryptorchidism** risk, painless mass that does not transilluminate) split into **seminoma** (radiosensitive, sheets with lymphocytes, **PLAP** positive, orchidectomy with surveillance or radiotherapy) and **nonseminoma** (**yolk sac AFP** raised, **choriocarcinoma hCG** with haemorrhage, embryonal aggressive, teratoma mixed). Staging (retroperitoneal nodes, lung) gates **RPLND** versus BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin lungs, cisplatin kidneys); tumour markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) stage and follow. Sex cord tumours (Leydig with precocity, Sertoli) are rarer.
steps.say: Painless solid young testis is germ cell until orchidectomy proves: AFP yolk sac, hCG choriocarcinoma. Seminoma radiosensitively surveils.

steps.tx: **Emergencies and benign scrotals** sort fast: **testicular torsion** (adolescent sudden pain with vomiting, **bell clapper** deformity, absent cremasteric, Doppler flow lost) needs **detorsion within 6 hours with bilateral orchiopexy**; epididymo-orchitis (chlamydia under 35, E. coli over 35, Prehn relief, antibiotics by age) mimics. **Left varicocele** (bag of worms, infertility, renal mass in new adult onset), hydrocele (transilluminates), spermatocele, and **penile SCC** (HPV, phimosis, lichen sclerosus, partial penectomy with node dissection) complete patterns.
steps.say: Sudden twisted teen testis with lost Doppler is torsion: untwist in 6 hours, fix both. Left bag of worms infertile is varicocele.
